positive_triggers: I am unsure which Agentic Brain workflow to use for this request.
This task may need more than one skill; help me choose the smallest useful sequence.
negative_triggers: The correct skill is already selected; complete its task.
List every skill in the repository.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: I want to add a small optional command-line flag to an existing tool, but I have not stated its behavior yet. Recommend the next step and only the workflow needed now.
pass_criteria: Recognizes that expected behavior is not yet defined and recommends clarifying/specifying it before implementation.
Does not prescribe the full development pipeline when only the next step is needed.
Uses only skills that are actually available and does not load or list the whole catalogue unnecessarily.
Asks a focused question or gives a concise next action without re-asking established facts.
